subject: On-prem BYOK: keystore attestation & egress evidence
messages:
From: Amira Khan <security@acmehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: J. Patel <j.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: On-prem BYOK: keystore attestation & egress evidence

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the product walkthrough last week. As we prepare the internal risk package for our on-prem deployment pilot, our security team needs a concise set of artifacts related to BYOK/key custody and network egress for the keystore (HSM proxy) integration. High-level ask below — we want items we can attach directly to the packet: 

- Keystore attestation evidence (what you can provide that proves control of key generation / no-plaintext egress).
- High-level network egress diagram showing what endpoints the keystore talks to (IP ranges, ports) and any connectors that signal telemetry out.
- Rotation policy summary (how often keys are rotated, rolling procedures, expected downtime or fallback).
- Confirmation of escrow/fallback: do you offer an escrow mechanism or split custody option for our on-prem private deployment?

Can you send a single ZIP or a short bundle we can include? If some items are sensitive, a short summary with references to an attestation PDF is fine.

We'd like to get this to our compliance committee by Friday so a reply in the next 72 hours would be ideal.

Thanks,
Amira Khan
Head of Security Operations
Acme Health

Attachments: acme_request_template.xlsx (sample questionnaire)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Khan <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: J. Patel <j.patel@acmehealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-prem BYOK: keystore attestation & egress evidence

Hi Amira — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura (security lead) and Tessa (on-prem ops) so we can pull the right artifacts and set expectations. Quick answers up front:

- We can provide a signed attestation PDF describing key provenance and that private key material never leaves the HSM in plaintext.
- We will produce a redacted network egress diagram listing public endpoints and IP ranges (we will redact internal infra CIDRs).
- Rotation: default rolling rotation cadence is 90 days for ephemeral wrapping keys; customer master keys are configurable (recommended 1 year) — we include a no-downtime rolling procedure and a fallback policy to a sealed-wrapped escrow key.
- Escrow: we support split-custody escrow with customer-provided KEK (BYOK) and optional sealed-wrapping to an escrow HSM under customer control; we can provide a procedural summary for your packet.

Action items:
1) Tessa — can your team assemble the artifacts: signed attestation, network egress diagram, and a one-page rotation summary. Prefer PDF and PNG.
2) Laura — we'll include the minimal legal-friendly attestation language; suggest we avoid including full operator logs in the packet (we can make logs available under an NDA).

Propose a 30-minute call Thurs 2026-12-10 08:30PT to run through items before we finalize. If that works for you Amira, we will send a calendar invite and a ZIP with the documents.

Thanks,
Rachel
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_kms_evidence_checklist.docx (internal checklist)

From: Amira Khan <security@acmehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: J. Patel <j.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-prem BYOK: keystore attestation & egress evidence

Rachel — that timing works, and thanks for the direct answers. A couple of follow-ups from our side after scanning the checklist during the call: 

- Can the attestation explicitly state: (a) which HSM model/firmware was used for key generation, (b) whether any operator-side key material is ever exported in the clear, and (c) the signing authority (Redwood legal or third-party auditor)?
- For the egress diagram please include the port ranges and SNI hostnames used; we need enough for firewall rules. If some of that is sensitive, a distinct document with a restricted label would be fine.
- Rotation windows: we prefer rotations to be scheduled in maintenance windows (UTC) and need the procedure for rollback if a wrapped-key restore fails.

Attached: acme_attestation_20261210.pdf (initial attestation), acme_onprem_egress_diagram.png (annotated). These are preliminary — please confirm whether they are sufficient.

On a related note: do you have a short blurb we can attach about the escrow workflow that describes customer control and the non-repudiation checks during an escrow handoff?

Thanks,
Amira

Attachments: acme_attestation_20261210.pdf, acme_onprem_egress_diagram.png

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Khan <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, J. Patel <j.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-prem BYOK: keystore attestation & egress evidence

Amira — appreciate the materials; review below and next steps.

Summary of what we'll attach to your compliance packet (PDFs/PNGs):
- Signed attestation (redwood_attestation_acme_20261212.pdf) — includes HSM model/firmware, generation provenance, and signing authority (Redwood security + independent auditor statement).
- Network egress diagram (redwood_acme_egress_annotated.png) — contains public IP ranges, SNI hostnames, and port lists; internal CIDRs redacted. We'll mark this document as "Restricted" and provide it under a limited-access link.
- Rotation and rollback one-pager (rotation_and_rollback_acme_20261212.pdf) — maintenance-window schedule, step-by-step rollback, validation checks, and expected RTO.
- Escrow workflow blotter (escrow_workflow_summary.txt) — short vendor-friendly blurb describing split custody, customer KEK binding, and non-repudiation checks performed during handoff; suitable for inclusion in procurement packet.

Notes and constraints:
- Operator logs: we cannot include raw operator logs in the packet. We can provide log excerpts or an auditor-signed summary under an NDA.
- Escrow: we will provide an optional sealed-wrapping escrow image; active transfer will require a custodial agreement and dual-signature ceremony.

Next steps:
- Tessa will deliver the ZIP with the four documents above and a link to the restricted egress diagram by EOD Monday 2026-12-13.
- Laura will provide the signed attestation and auditor statement.
- Rachel to confirm the DocuSign link for the custodial agreement (I will follow up Monday).

If that timeline meets your Friday committee deadline, we'll mark the submission as "For Compliance Review" and include a short cover memo. If you need the restricted egress file earlier, tell us which firewall owner email to share with.

Best,
Rachel
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
